canonical_json: UTF-8, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(comma,colon), allow_nan=False; no trailing newline
lookup_policy: Primitive strings and finite numbers under evidence/evidence_refs/evidence_ids lists only. Dictionary pool keys or list number/id fields identify units; str(value) is used only for lookup. Missing/ambiguous refs fail. All original fields, reference types and paths survive; inline literal objects are not inferred refs.
data_used: Existing generic v14 Python/tests/validation, generic v2 resolver code, and synthetic neutral records only; no source rules, real questions/keys, outputs, grades, audits, progress or case data.
new_guard: Complete original-question/original-answer own-review display with exact literal/ID association, full explicitly linked evidence, UTF-8 text/hash/size metadata, and bounded display compatibility. No IO, answer generation or semantic grading inside the helper.
